observation: Fifty-five loose solids in the opening setup, with the bank markers rebuilt as four engraved V ticks on the centre bar top. Top: twenty-four lane tiles fan from the hub to one clean outer circle, tones strictly alternating, a constant thin orange margin at all twenty-four boundaries, no notch, bay or scallop in any tile end, and the four ticks reading as deliberate quadrant marks on an otherwise flat bar. Thirty teardrop counters sit two, five, three and five to a lane on the correct points; each is inside its own lane. The rim is forty-eight separate curled flames standing off an unbroken disc edge with open background in every valley; no closed loop, arch, ribbon or handle anywhere. Iso: every tile is seated and stands slightly proud, the bar is the highest plane, nothing floats or interpenetrates. Front: a flat 6.2 mm board with counters resting on the tile tops. No part is missing, extra, oversized or misplaced.
